source_gene.selection: highest raw count in the demo cell among universe genes

check.cross_check_method: second central finite difference at step=1

symmetry_probe.target_selection: largest |d response / d source count| among genes present in the cell
symmetry_probe.verdict_criterion: cross-entry gap >10% => asymmetric, but only when the Jacobian estimate is stable (Pearson >= 0.99 and relative L2 difference <= 0.5 between step sizes)
symmetry_probe.note: the Jacobian estimate itself is step-dependent here (primary vs cross-check Pearson 0.9991, relative L2 difference 1.3788), so the asymmetry cannot be separated from estimation error

substitutions: replaced BertSelfFlashAttention.forward with a shape-correct SDPA implementation: the shipped non-flash fallback softmaxes across heads instead of across the sequence, and the flash-attention path is fp16/bf16 only with no forward-mode derivative. Weights and attention mathematics are unchanged; the kernel and dtype are not.
